test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 05 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Two similar triangles have area 490 sq. cm. and 640 sq. cm. If the length of the one side of the first triangle is 21 cm, then what is the length of the corresponding side of the second triangle?
solution:
**Given:**

Area of first triangle (A₁) = 490 sq. cm

Area of second triangle (A₂) = 640 sq. cm

Length of one side of the first triangle (S₁) = 21 cm

**Formula used:**

For similar triangles, the ratio of the areas is equal to the square of the ratio of the corresponding sides.
